name: Saudi Oil Burn Forecaster
info: Time series forecasting model that predicts Saudi Arabia's oil consumption/burn using SARIMA (Seasonal AutoRegressive Integrated Moving Average). The model analyzes historical oil consumption patterns and generates forecasts with confidence intervals.

parameters.name: forecast_steps
parameters.tooltip: Number of time periods (months) to forecast ahead. Default is 12 months (1 year).

parameters.name: include_history
parameters.tooltip: Whether to include historical data context in the response for visualization purposes.

output.description: Time series forecast with confidence intervals

format.forecast_dates: Array of forecast dates in YYYY-MM-DD format
format.forecasted_values: Array of predicted oil consumption values in million barrels per day
format.lower_confidence_interval: Array of lower bound confidence interval values
format.upper_confidence_interval: Array of upper bound confidence interval values
format.units: Unit of measurement (Million barrels per day)
